repos.name: spotifyHero
repos.description: Desktop app that turns your Spotify tracks into a Friday Night Funkin' / Guitar Hero-style experience. Auto-generated notes play alongside your screen, jump in anytime via keybind. Includes scoring, leaderboards, and easy sharing to challenge friends on any song.

repos.name: portfolioSite
repos.description: This repo is for my portfoio site. It's a showcase of my software engineering projects, technical experiments, and coding journey. It's basically a resume with better syntax highlighting.

repos.name: recordMe
repos.description: IoT device designed to record, transcribe, save, and upload day-to-day conversations onto an external cloud storage server. Once stored there, a local LLM can be used as a medium through which the user can observe trends relating to their conversations.

repos.name: autoDocker
repos.description: A python script that uses active API to automatically containerize project files without human involvement. Use "distroless" / Alpine images to reduce the attack surface, multi-stage builds to keep the final image small, and an LLM API (like Gemini or OpenAI) to read the code and write the Dockerfile dynamically based on the actual logic it sees.
